airless: Airless means the same as close or stuffy or unaired.
airlike: Airlike means resembling air or having the form of air.
Airlike means the same as aeriform.
airsick: Airsick means the same as air sick or carsick or seasick.
airtight: Airtight means having no weak points.
Airtight can also mean not allowing air or gas to pass in or out.
Airtight means the same as air-tight or gas-tight.
airy: Airy means open to or abounding in fresh air.
Airy can also mean not practical or realizable.
Airy can also mean having little or no perceptible weight.
Airy means the same as aired or impractical or visionary.
airily: Airily means in a flippant manner.
For example: "He answered the reporters' questions flippantly."
Airily means the same as flippantly.
